hints.title: Effective Room Capacity Pre-computation
hints.text: A box can only reach room i if its height does not exceed the height of any preceding room from 0 to i.

hints.title: Prefix Minimum Transformation
hints.text: Transform warehouse heights using running minimums: warehouse[i] = min(warehouse[i], warehouse[i - 1]).

hints.title: Greedy Smallest Box Placement
hints.text: Sort boxes ascending, and iterate backward through warehouse rooms placing the smallest available box that fits.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting boxes takes O(B log B) time, and warehouse scanning executes in linear O(W) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all box orderings leads to combinatorial search over factorials.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix minimum in-place modification allows greedy two-pointer matching in constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Monotonic prefix-min reduction followed by greedy matching.
